description: A book placed on one of a reader's shelves. Unlike bookStatus, which carries the reading status of an edition, a shelfItem is a plain membership edge: one record per (shelf, book) pair, so a book can sit on any number of custom shelves independently of its reading status. The rkey is `<shelf rkey>-<edition rkey>`, so the same pair always lands on the same record.

shelf.description: AT-URI of the shelf record this book belongs to.

book.description: The book on the shelf (catalog edition record URI).

metadata.description: Optional position, notes and emoji for this book's place on the shelf.
